Spatial Bin

  • CURIE: gmeow:SpatialBin
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SpatialBin
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/aggregation

A place that serves as a spatial bin in an aggregation grid — a generated region used to partition space for statistical summarisation. Its geometry defines the bin boundary; its aggregation result is a SpatialAggregation.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Place

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:SpatialBin as a specialized kind of gmeow:Place. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Place
